entries.title: Fetch from server fills in OpenCode Go's model sizes
entries.body: A custom API connection now reads the context and output sizes OpenCode's model list states, so a model picked from the list no longer needs its sizes typed by hand. Models the server says take no chat turn, such as decision and embedding models, show Not a chat model and can't be picked, since they could never pass the check Save runs.

picture.alt: A custom API connection's model list: two picked models with their context and output sizes filled in, and decision and embedding models marked Not a chat model.
